 Thicknesse vs. Chopurov Pick, Prediction
 Asaf Chopurov, the UAE Warriors champ, was considered one of the best non-UFC fighters in MMA. Still, he will make his octagon debut on Saturday against Alexander Volkanovski's chief training partner, Colby Thicknesse.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Thicknesse is well-rounded and has never been finished, but he has little finishing power himself; the question is whether he can survive and cover a near 5-1 price tag by surviving against a dangerous debutant.
 Thicknesse came close to falling against both Vince Morales and Josias Musasa in recent wins, and Chopurov – who has just 11 pro fights but 35 amateur MMA bouts under his belt- has a wealth of experience at 24 years old.
 I projected this fight to reach a decision about 45% of the time, compared to a divisional average closer to 54%, and I still see value on the goes-to-decision or distance prop, compared to listed odds of +180.
 Bet Over 2.5 Rounds (+130) or the Fight Goes the Distance Prop (+180) down to +135.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Moreover, I show correlated value on Chopurov to win by decision (projected +195, listed +250) at +225 or better.
